newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia sets internal coffee price at record high.
newsitem.headline: Colombia sets internal coffee price at record high.

text.p: Colombia Friday raised its internal coffee price to a record-high of 310,250 pesos per 125-kg load in a bid to bring it closer into line with overseas prices.
A spokesman for the National Coffee Growers' Federation said the new price, the second to be announced since Monday, was likely to hold at least through next week.
Colombia's internal price was raised to 248,125 psos per 125-kg load on Jan 31. But the hike fell short of growers' expectations in light of the recent run-up in prices in London and New York.

The price was raised again Monday to 290,000 pesos but growers, still voicing discontent, said private exporters were offering them as much as 320,000 pesos per load in the face of tight local supply.

The new price was announced on the sidelines of a two-day meeting of Latin Amerian coffee officials, partly sponsored by the National Coffee Growers' Federation, in this city in central-western Colombia. ((-- Juan Guillermo Londoo, Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944))
